# Wooffy

> Wooffy is the pet membership community for Cyprus: a dog-friendly directory, lost and found alerts, shelter adoptions, partner discounts and pet health tools for dog and cat owners.

Free and Paid memberships are available. Partner businesses offer member discounts, and part of membership revenue supports animal shelters in Cyprus.

## Pages

- [Home](https://wooffy.app/): What Wooffy is, membership plans and partners.
- [Blog](https://wooffy.app/blog): Pet care guides, partner interviews and adoption stories from Cyprus.
- [Community](https://wooffy.app/community): Questions and answers from Cyprus pet owners.
- [Become a partner](https://wooffy.app/partner-register): Register a pet business or shelter.
- [Terms](https://wooffy.app/terms): Terms and conditions.

## Optional

- [Peanut butter for dogs](https://wooffy.app/blog/peanut-butter-for-dogs-healthy-or-not): Example guide article.
